          • Record/Vinyl + Digital Album

            • The superb new album by the legendary Pallas.

            • Limited 2LP edition.

            A year in the making, the album unmistakably follows the line of Pallas albums but with some fundamental differences. The voices of all four band members are featured equally, with each musician taking a share of lead vocals and backing vocals with a focus on layered harmony vocals, a feature more in line with some of the band's earlier recordings.

            At first glance, the album's lyrics appear to make reference to Biblical events, politics, technology and conflict - but looking deeper, the album is ultimately about people and human interaction, relationships, moods and emotions; what inspires us as individuals and the contrast between our inner selves and what we let others see; how we pick ourselves up after falling; our vulnerabilities; our self-destructive tendencies making significant life changes.

            'A Song For Tomorrow' may be a legacy for the future, but it is very much a selection of songs for today.
